hard_boundaries.prediction_archives: not required; metrics receipt is the tracked result

model.selection_rule: native-1024 valid sample-first relative RMSE; no reselection

dataset.truth_source: valid_iid rows only from frozen full_fields.h5

input_contract.conditioning: stored P1i 1024 support coordinates + kx/ky/kz + q + four boundary flags + top/bottom Robin h
input_contract.query: all 240825 frozen P1i full-field coordinates with deterministic k/q/boundary fields materialized from case definition
input_contract.support_selector: the support points stored in each P1i sample; no new learned adapter
input_contract.u_v2: frozen asymmetric native-1024 conditioning plus direct-query output graph
input_contract.coordinate_note: P1i physical coordinates are retained; e200 normalization was fit on the DeepOHeat-v1 domain. This is a zero-shot cross-benchmark transfer diagnostic, not a same-domain training comparison.

metrics.cv_weighted_point_global: 100*sqrt(sum_case CV-weighted SSE / sum_case CV-weighted truth energy)
metrics.rmse_K: sqrt(sum node squared error / node count)
metrics.peak_temperature_rmse_K: sqrt(mean over valid cases of peak error squared)
metrics.hotspot: top 1 percent nodes by T_true within each valid sample (2409 nodes); prediction never defines hotspot
metrics.dispersion: mean plus SD across the three independent training seeds; not 384 independent observations

execution.batching: U-v2 cases are evaluated one at a time to keep graph/query memory bounded
execution.output_policy: per-seed JSON receipts under a devbox ignored output directory; no prediction arrays committed

interpretation.fairness: not same training domain, not same information budget, and not a replacement for a P1i-trained Heat3D cohort
interpretation.winner_claim: forbidden without a pre-registered common-domain cohort and matched training contract
